title: Propose Day special single-page landing (React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui)

requirements.summary: Build a responsive single-page Propose Day landing page with a romantic hero and clear scrollable section structure.
acceptanceCriteria: Page renders as a cohesive single-page experience on desktop and mobile without horizontal scrolling
Hero section includes a prominent headline, 1–2 lines of supporting text, and a primary CTA button
Content is organized into distinct sections with consistent spacing and typography

file_operations.description: Create the app root that renders a single-page Propose Day layout with clearly separated sections (hero, message, reasons/notes, proposal question, footer) and responsive container/spacing using Tailwind. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Button, Card, Separator) for consistent structure; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create section components (HeroSection, MessageSection, ReasonsSection, ProposalSection, FooterSection) composed into a single scrolling page; include semantic headings and consistent section spacing. Use shadcn-ui components (e.g., Card) where appropriate; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Add a small hook to support smooth scrolling from the hero CTA to the proposal section using refs/ids; keep behavior purely client-side.
Verify the App import resolves correctly and keep providers intact; ensure the single-page Propose Day experience is the primary rendered UI.

requirements.summary: Add a client-side interactive “Will you be mine?” section with Yes/Not yet buttons and corresponding confirmation/secondary states.
acceptanceCriteria: Proposal section includes at minimum two buttons: “Yes” and “Not yet”
Clicking “Yes” transitions to a visible confirmation state (e.g., message card, animation, or banner)
Clicking “Not yet” shows a polite message without breaking layout or navigation
Reloading the page resets the interaction state (no backend storage)

file_operations.description: Implement the proposal interaction UI with two buttons (“Yes”, “Not yet”) and internal React state to swap between default/confirmation/secondary states; ensure page reload resets state. Use shadcn-ui Button and Card/Alert styling for states; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Wire ProposalInteraction into the proposal question section so it is visible in the page flow and reachable via scrolling; ensure the section remains non-blocking and layout-stable on state changes.

requirements.summary: Apply a cohesive romantic visual theme (no blue/purple) with consistent palette, typography scale, spacing, and decorative elements across all sections.
acceptanceCriteria: Theme uses a romantic palette (e.g., blush/rose/cream with warm accent like gold) and is applied consistently across sections
Buttons, cards, and headings follow a consistent component style
All user-facing text is in English

file_operations.description: Define global theme tokens and base styles using Tailwind (and shadcn-style CSS variables) with a romantic palette (blush/rose/cream + warm gold accent), ensuring no blue/purple tones; set consistent typography defaults and section spacing utilities via Tailwind classes used in components.
Extend/adjust Tailwind theme configuration if needed to support the romantic palette (via CSS variables or additional named colors) and ensure consistent typography/spacing utilities across the page.

Apply consistent Tailwind class patterns for headings, body text, cards, buttons, and decorative elements across all sections; keep all user-facing copy in English. Use shadcn-ui components for consistent button/card styling; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Add required generated images as static assets and integrate them into the page design responsively without layout shift.
acceptanceCriteria: Generated images exist in frontend/public/assets/generated with the specified filenames
The page loads and displays the images without routing through the backend
Images are responsive (scale/crop appropriately) and do not cause layout shift

file_operations.description: Add the generated romantic hero background illustration static asset at this exact path/filename for direct frontend use.
Add the generated heart emblem/icon static asset at this exact path/filename for direct frontend use.
Add the generated repeating heart pattern tile static asset at this exact path/filename for direct frontend use.

Incorporate static images into the design: use frontend/public/assets/generated/propose-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png in the hero (background/illustration), frontend/public/assets/generated/heart-emblem.dim_512x512.png as a motif/icon, and frontend/public/assets/generated/heart-pattern-tile.dim_512x512.png as a subtle decorative pattern. Ensure responsive sizing/cropping and reserve space (e.g., fixed aspect containers) to avoid layout shift.
